description: 02_JRC-EU-TIMES Building Stock Module is published by European Commission, Joint Research Centre. It describes an Excel building-stock calibration module for JRC-EU-TIMES, using dwelling categories, construction vintage, insulation and occupancy. Spatial scope is continental (European Union). Spatial detail: Building archetypes grouped by dwelling category and six vintage groups. The full data period remains unverified. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links.
